cases.requirement: Consent binds the exact run, record address and digest
cases.preconditions: A finished run with passing gate
steps: Compare each recipient's allocation and applied policy ceiling on the total-offered scale; inspect the policy source
Copy the exact digest; confirm that copying does not approve or change server-recorded custody state
cases.expected_outcome: One synthetic record; public S3 is unchanged; collection remains unconfirmed. Bars use the full offer: 20 kg allocated against a 96 kg cap for 240 kg at the server's 40%, not 40% of shelter capacity. Non-40% fractions use the exact exposed value. Digest labels distinguish draft, sandbox record and published record without claiming a Merkle proof or independent custody verification.
cases.negative_recovery_case: Stale digest, missing consent, duplicate approval and changed relevant sources are refused. Missing/invalid cap or no plan never assumes 40%; zero/unknown totals do not infer percentages. Clipboard denial leaves a selectable exact digest. Long fractional caps must not trigger phone-number refusal; raw metadata stays private.
